# Databento DBN Python 3.15 source build

This licensed source is official DBN 0.70.0 revision [aa012adc](https://github.com/databento/dbn/tree/aa012adc6502e01b01d7b5c7836742dde21e93d8). [PROVENANCE.json](PROVENANCE.json) records every official SDK file hash and the complete changed-file boundary. The original [Apache-2.0 license](LICENSE) is retained. No SDK enum values, repr methods, records, encoders, decoders or datasets are changed.

The current PyO3 0.29.3 crate is retained under [vendor/pyo3](vendor/pyo3), including its [MIT](vendor/pyo3/LICENSE-MIT) and [Apache-2.0](vendor/pyo3/LICENSE-APACHE) licenses and upstream VCS metadata. Explicit vendor Git attributes preserve the four crate-distribution CRLF files byte-for-byte; the source and existing tests are not normalized. Its single runtime source change in [create_type_object.rs](vendor/pyo3/src/pyclass/create_type_object.rs) replaces an already registered `Py_tp_repr` pointer when a later custom repr is registered. Simple enums otherwise register both the generated and custom repr slots. CPython 3.15 deprecates duplicate slots; strict warning handling turned actual SDK import into an initialization panic. This change preserves CPython's previous last-slot-wins behavior and leaves every unrelated slot unchanged.

Maturin uses the active `[project] requires-python = ">=3.10"`. The official unused Poetry tool table still says `<3.15`; it is retained byte-for-byte and is not used by this PEP 517 backend.

The official SDK Python project metadata remains unchanged at [python/pyproject.toml](python/pyproject.toml). The root [pyproject.toml](pyproject.toml) uses the same metadata with explicit Rust/Python source paths and includes the patched PyO3 source in its source archive. The root Cargo patch is relative; its lock selects matching current PyO3 0.29.3 components. The maintained Hft project selects this complete source through uv. No ABI forwarding or binary relabeling is used.

Checks use the actual complete 67-package graph. All variants of all 20 exported SDK enum classes have identical repr, str, name and value to the official build. The SDK decodes the same official two-row MBO fixture to identical dataframe JSON and dtypes. That fixture is only an SDK decoder control; it never replaces the absent Hft `tmp_20240501.npz` archive. Hft original cases and numerical settings are unchanged. No new Hft test cases are introduced.
